<script>
    // Search by product name or SKU.
    const searchInput = document.getElementById("inventorySearch");
    const tableRows = document.querySelectorAll("#inventoryTable tbody tr");

    searchInput.addEventListener("input", function () {
        const query = this.value.trim().toLowerCase();

        tableRows.forEach(function (row) {
            const text = row.textContent.toLowerCase();
            row.style.display = text.includes(query) ? "" : "none";
        });
    });

    // Calculate total available stock and low/out-of-stock products.
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#inventoryTable tbody tr");

    let totalStock = 0;
    let lowStockCount = 0;

    rows.forEach(function (row) {
        const quantityCell = row.querySelector(".quantity");

        // Ignore the empty-state row.
        if (!quantityCell) {
            return;
        }

        totalStock += Number(quantityCell.textContent.trim());

        const status = row.querySelector(".badge");

        if (
            status &&
            (
                status.classList.contains("low-stock") ||
                status.classList.contains("out-of-stock")
            )
        ) {
            lowStockCount++;
        }
    });

    document.getElementById("totalStock").textContent = totalStock;
    document.getElementById("lowStockCount").textContent = lowStockCount;
</script>

<script>
            const table = document.getElementById("product-table");
            const addButton = document.getElementById("add-row");
            const saveButton = document.getElementById("save-rows");
            const message = document.getElementById("save-message");

            const categories = [
                {% for category in categories %}
                    {
                        id: "{{ category.id|escapejs }}",
                        name: "{{ category.name|escapejs }}"
                    },
                {% endfor %}
            ];

            function makeInput(name, type = "text", value = "") {
                const input = document.createElement("input");
                input.name = name;
                input.type = type;
                input.value = value;
                return input;
            }

            function addCell(row, element) {
                const cell = document.createElement("td");
                cell.appendChild(element);
                row.appendChild(cell);
                return cell;
            }

            function addProductRow() {
                document.getElementById("empty-row")?.remove();

                const row = document.createElement("tr");
                row.className = "new-product-row";

                const number = document.createElement("td");
                number.textContent = "New";
                row.appendChild(number);

                addCell(row, makeInput("name"));
                addCell(row, makeInput("sku"));

                const categorySelect = document.createElement("select");
                categorySelect.name = "category";
                categorySelect.required = true;

                const placeholder = document.createElement("option");
                placeholder.value = "";
                placeholder.textContent = "Choose category";
                categorySelect.appendChild(placeholder);

                categories.forEach(category => {
                    const option = document.createElement("option");
                    option.value = category.id;
                    option.textContent = category.name;
                    categorySelect.appendChild(option);
                });

                addCell(row, categorySelect);
                addCell(row, makeInput("brand"));
                addCell(row, makeInput("purchase_price", "number"));
                addCell(row, makeInput("selling_price", "number"));
                addCell(row, makeInput("unit", "text", "Piece"));
                addCell(row, makeInput("low_stock_threshold", "number", "10"));

                const statusSelect = document.createElement("select");
                statusSelect.name = "is_active";

                [["true", "Active"], ["false", "Inactive"]].forEach(item => {
                    const option = document.createElement("option");
                    option.value = item[0];
                    option.textContent = item[1];
                    statusSelect.appendChild(option);
                });

                addCell(row, statusSelect);

                const removeCell = document.createElement("td");
                const removeButton = document.createElement("button");
                removeButton.type = "button";
                removeButton.className = "btn secondary";
                removeButton.textContent = "Remove";
                removeButton.addEventListener("click", () => row.remove());
                removeCell.appendChild(removeButton);
                row.appendChild(removeCell);

                table.appendChild(row);
                row.querySelector('input[name="name"]').focus();
            }

            addButton.addEventListener("click", addProductRow);

            saveButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
                const rows = Array.from(
                    table.querySelectorAll(".new-product-row")
                );

                if (!rows.length) {
                    message.textContent = "Add at least one new product row.";
                    return;
                }

                const products = rows.map(row => {
                    const data = {};
                    row.querySelectorAll("input, select").forEach(field => {
                        data[field.name] = field.value;
                    });
                    return data;
                });

                saveButton.disabled = true;
                message.textContent = "Saving products...";

                try {
                    const csrfToken = document.querySelector(
                        "#csrf-form [name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]"
                    ).value;

                    const response = await fetch("{% url 'inline_save' %}", {
                        method: "POST",
                        headers: {
                            "Content-Type": "application/json",
                            "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken
                        },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ products })
                    });

                    const result = await response.json();

                    if (!response.ok || !result.success) {
                        const details = (result.errors || []).map(item => {
                            const fields = Object.entries(item.errors)
                                .map(([field, errors]) => {
                                    const messages = errors.map(error =>
                                        typeof error === "string"
                                            ? error
                                            : error.message
                                    ).join(", ");
                                    return `${field}: ${messages}`;
                                }).join(" | ");

                            return `Row ${item.row}: ${fields}`;
                        });

                        message.textContent = [
                            result.message || "Please correct the rows.",
                            ...details
                        ].join(" ");
                        return;
                    }

                    message.textContent = result.message;
                    window.location.reload();
                } catch (error) {
                    message.textContent =
                        "Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.";
                } finally {
                    saveButton.disabled = false;
                }
            });
        </script>
